stemEn: An infant with failure to thrive was found to have hypokalemia, metabolic alkalosis, and hypertension. What is the most likely diagnosis?
explanationAr: وجود hypertension مع hypokalemia وmetabolic alkalosis في طفل صغير هو النمط الذي يختاره المصدر لـLiddle syndrome بسبب increased epithelial sodium-channel activity. Bartter وGitelman عادةً salt-wasting مع normal/low BP، بينما pseudohypoaldosteronism يسبب salt wasting وhyperkalemia.
reasoningEn: Young-onset hypertension with hypokalemic metabolic alkalosis is the classic recalled pattern for Liddle syndrome.
incorrectOptionsAr: Bartter وGitelman يسببان renal salt wasting وغالبًا لا يسببان hypertension. Pseudohypoaldosteronism type 1 يسبب hyponatremia/hypovolemia مع hyperkalemia وليس hypokalemia.
clinicalPearl: Liddle syndrome mimics hyperaldosteronism clinically but has suppressed renin and aldosterone.

stemEn: A 2-month-old infant with failure to thrive was found to have polyuria, hypokalemia, hyponatremia, metabolic alkalosis, and nephrocalcinosis. What is the most likely diagnosis?
explanationAr: Early infancy + polyuria + salt wasting + hypokalemic metabolic alkalosis + nephrocalcinosis هي clues قوية في المصدر لـBartter syndrome.
reasoningEn: The neonatal/infantile salt-wasting phenotype with hypokalemic metabolic alkalosis and nephrocalcinosis supports Bartter syndrome.
incorrectOptionsAr: Gitelman غالبًا يظهر لاحقًا ويتميز hypomagnesemia وhypocalciuria. Liddle يسبب hypertension لا salt wasting. Distal RTA يسبب metabolic acidosis وليس alkalosis.
clinicalPearl: Nephrocalcinosis is a high-yield clue favoring Bartter over Gitelman syndrome.

stemEn: An infant with failure to thrive presented with polyuria. Serum sodium was 126 and potassium was 2.2. What is the most likely diagnosis?
explanationAr: المصدر يربط infantile polyuria مع hyponatremia وmarked hypokalemia بـBartter syndrome كـsalt-losing tubulopathy. لكن غياب bicarbonate/acid-base data يجعل السؤال أقل اكتمالًا من Q17، لذلك يبقى للتحقق.
reasoningEn: The recalled age and salt-wasting pattern favor Bartter syndrome, although the stem omits acid-base data.
incorrectOptionsAr: Pseudohypoaldosteronism عادةً يسبب hyperkalemia. Hyperaldosteronism قد يسبب hypokalemia لكنه مع hypertension لا salt-wasting hyponatremia. Distal RTA يتطلب metabolic acidosis.
clinicalPearl: When differentiating renal salt-wasting disorders, BP and acid-base status are essential clues.

stemEn: A patient was admitted to the PICU. After being transferred to the ward, he developed oliguria and edema. Labs showed metabolic alkalosis (pH 7.54, HCO3 31, PCO2 65), hypokalemia (K 2.7), hypochloremia, with normal BUN and creatinine. What is the most likely cause?
explanationAr: المصدر نفسه يقول إنه لا يمكن اختيار إجابة واحدة من المعلومات المحفوظة. وفي 2023 كانت هناك معلومة إضافية جعلت الجواب واضحًا لكن لم يحفظها جامعو السؤال. لذلك لم نعتمد furosemide أو أي خيار آخر تلقائيًا.
reasoningEn: The source explicitly states that the recalled stem is insufficient to identify one correct answer and that a missing 2023 hint changed the interpretation.
incorrectOptionsAr: لا يمكن استبعاد/اعتماد الخيارات بثقة من النص الحالي وحده. يلزم استرجاع الـmissing hint، وقد تساعد urine chloride, medication history, BP/volume status and diarrhea history في التفريق.
clinicalPearl: Hypokalemic hypochloremic metabolic alkalosis requires clinical context such as diuretic exposure, urine chloride and volume/BP status.
diagnosticSteps: Recover original exam hint if possible
Consider urine chloride and volume status

stemEn: A case scenario was given about a patient who was taking a thiazide. Which electrolyte abnormality is the patient prone to?
explanationAr: المصدر يختار hyponatremia كـelectrolyte adverse effect للـthiazides. Thiazides قد تسبب أيضًا hypokalemia، وتقلل urinary calcium excretion بدل أن تسبب hypercalciuria.
reasoningEn: Thiazides can cause hyponatremia through impaired urinary dilution and sodium loss; the source keys C.
incorrectOptionsAr: Hyperkalemia ليست النمط المعتاد؛ thiazides تميل إلى hypokalemia. Hypercalciuria غير متوقعة لأن thiazides تقلل urinary calcium excretion.
clinicalPearl: Thiazides can cause hyponatremia, hypokalemia and hyperuricemia while reducing urinary calcium excretion.

stemEn: Which of the following is a side effect of thiazide?
explanationAr: المصدر يختار hyperuricemia كأحد الآثار الجانبية المعروفة للـthiazide.
reasoningEn: Thiazides can decrease urate excretion and cause hyperuricemia.
incorrectOptionsAr: Hypoglycemia ليست side effect نموذجية للـthiazides؛ قد ترتبط أكثر بhyperglycemia/glucose intolerance.
clinicalPearl: A classic thiazide adverse-effect cluster includes hyponatremia, hypokalemia, hyperuricemia and metabolic effects on glucose/lipids.

stemEn: A preterm infant on furosemide (Lasix) for bronchopulmonary dysplasia presented with hematuria. What is the most likely cause of this hematuria?
explanationAr: المصدر يربط loop diuretic therapy في preterm infants بزيادة urinary calcium excretion ثم nephrocalcinosis؛ لذلك اختار hypercalciuria كسبب hematuria.
reasoningEn: Furosemide inhibits NaCl reabsorption in the thick ascending limb and increases urinary calcium loss, predisposing premature infants to hypercalciuria and nephrocalcinosis.
incorrectOptionsAr: بقية الخيارات غير محفوظة في المصدر، لذلك لم تُختلق.
clinicalPearl: Loop diuretics increase calciuria; thiazides decrease calciuria.
diagnosticSteps: Consider urine calcium assessment and renal ultrasound when clinically indicated
